blocks.text: Course note: Begin by examining a current difficulty, the reasons attached to it, and the choices still available.

Honestly bro tbh you just sound like you're spoiled. 😭 I'm not trying to say you are, nor dissing you. You have no complete reason to hate your life, just like a lot of people, but as human beings we give reasons. Reasons to hate it, reasons to not care or like it. We validate it even when it's not real. Ofc it's real but the validation isn't. Your bored but do you know completely why your bored, have you thought well where does it come from, beyond not having anything to do or friends, where does it reside and where does the thoughts stem from? Self awareness/perception. Having the metacognition. Think about a rich girl hating their mom because their supra was green instead of their favorite color blue. In our minds it will be their spoiled. But in their head it's as if their mom didn't care enough, as If she just had a vendetta. You get to used to something, that when something of high expectation doesn't come, it makes you react emotionally according to how you are. I remember when I was a kid, literally would be left home for hours on end, no food in the house, my sister comes home, she has food but I don't. I was forgotten about, I was mad, I was sad, why did my sister get something, why did they not think of me? But everytime it happened, I just understood that you can't expect to be given anything. 

I wasn't given glamor, I was given a life though, my life was supposed to worse, I was supposed to be brain dead by now, unable to walk, but I'm doing this with you. Grace. Do you have grace? The whole point of all this is just grace. Once you start appreciating even the little things, the things that show you it isn't that bad and you have that freedom of doing more, then it transforms boredom to something more. Maybe it doesn't but everything else doesn't matter because at least you have this. You can want, you can desire, you can be prideful, you can be greedy, but knowing and understanding that you have something, or at least being grateful for it make things a lot better.

blocks.text: Course note: Practice asking precise questions before working with regret, comparison, and emotion.

Hm really good. I want to know though, what do you mean in the first one. I want you to deeply reflect, break it down, dissect it, in one big paragraph, look at the phrasing of your words, the mindset it comes from, what it could intentionally tell you, how it effects you, and why it's harmful. Does it make you believe in yourself more? Does it pull you closer to what you need to be it? Does it follow your will? That's how you really have to dissect some of these negative thoughts, because in reality it only makes a little sense because you're giving a sample logic claim in full emotional rampant dysfunctional claim. But that small sample can fool us into believing it. Just think of people who sell stuff, a simple number change can make us think better or worse of a product. That's how you have to abstractively think about how the mind works.

blocks.text: Course note: Use self-inquiry to examine the past while preparing to act in the present.

Imma be real. Its 2026. You either live on or live backwards. To me it is useless to think that way. Because once you truly think about it, what does judging your past self do when that person got you to where you are to day, allowed to have a choice, a chance to see and learn from it, to make a choice today or tomorrow or even the next day, to change or evolve, even so slightly. Judging your past is worthless when you already acted and moved on to the next day, but learning from it is valuable, it is the past for reason. You're in the present, what you felt than, how you felt, what you understood, how you thought, what you hated, look at those, look at them truthfully, understand than know that the person there is no longer because the person now was able to look at that person, at their shadows and sit with them in your mind. Your gonna have demons everyday, your gonna have these things that drive you down when it can easily drive you forward. This year, isn't about what you can do, but what shift you're gonna make mentally. Don't fret on what you have done and couldve, focus on what you can do, what you have the potential to do, this is the time to look back and know that with your knowledge, that wisdom now, you can look back and know the potential, the abilities, the thinking, the intelligence you're able to see in your life moving forward. I would say every little thing, every little detail about what you said. But thats useless to me because it'll be the same thing, it'll be useless because it serves nothing but a comfortable mat for the past you had to accept. This is the moment, the time. That reflection, you needed that to see what you always known. Instead of thinking of what was, think what is. That person you saw was pathetic, you could learn so much from that man, and you have so much you can learn from yourself now. You're right you'll be 17, no matter what, you wasted your teens, hell even I did, I said I would, dreamt of doing good things and being better, yet that only came with wisdom, this is life, thats how it is. But the difference is, that it doesnt matter to me, because when I slept, I woke up. And I wake up everyday and if I continue to wake up everyday, than that means I have a infinite amount of opportunity of still doing something right as much as wrong. I can't fail myself, no matter how much I believed that I wasted those moments, those were the times I had, I learned and gained so much from my exprience. So I'll regret anything, because to be pulled by the past, is to be dragged by yourself and only you, and im sorry, no past version of me can't beat me nor drag me, there is nothing that can stop, they may be wise but im wiser, they mightve been smarter educated, but im smarter and more exprienced. Nothing in my mind, nothing make sense to lose to the me who created this reality we have now. The whole point is to learn and become better through time. Why disrespect yourself for everything you went through, instead of walking through the path they made, knowing it may not be the best one. It is useless for me to think bad about myself as no bad words hold no weight against me, I know me more than anyone. You are the same, and capable of such. I'm not saying be like me ofc. But its 2026, it was 2025, 2023, 2021. In a few years this will be but a fleeting moment, a past memory like everything else was. Its time to unshackle yourself from your sins of guilt and resentment, and focus on what you know your responsibility is. You said you would like to kill yourself, but unfortunately you have the responsibility of living, thats it and thats all, whatever you do or what life gives you, is just food on the plate for the exprience called life. Nothing more, nothing less. Its up to you to make it meaningful, create purpose, goals, dreams. Even if you have nothing, you have the opportunity to live and with a mindset, you can have everything.

Honestly if he just got back in the city, something like that isnt what someone is gonna want to advocate to. So the distinction will be not care, because caring about someone and showing up for someone are not the same thing. Yes you really want something and youd most likely do the same for your friend, but that doesnt mean that exist for everyone. So you cant really expect it, thats just how life works. Tell him what you need to talk to him about, you can't make someone think about oh it might be the living situation or moving. Simply no one owes anything, simply ask him, tell him what its about, if he doesnt answer on a agreed day or they don't reciprocate that's when you be like ok. And then leave it there.

blocks.text: What does it look like to work from the life you actually have?

Honestly bro tbh you just sound like you're spoiled. 😭 I'm not trying to say you are, nor dissing you. You have no complete reason to hate your life, just like a lot of people, but as human beings we give reasons. Reasons to hate it, reasons to not care or like it. We validate it even when it's not real. Ofc it's real but the validation isn't. Your bored but do you know completely why your bored, have you thought well where does it come from, beyond not having anything to do or friends, where does it reside and where does the thoughts stem from? Self awareness/perception. Having the metacognition. Think about a rich girl hating their mom because their supra was green instead of their favorite color blue. In our minds it will be their spoiled. But in their head it's as if their mom didn't care enough, as If she just had a vendetta. You get to used to something, that when something of high expectation doesn't come, it makes you react emotionally according to how you are. I remember when I was a kid, literally would be left home for hours on end, no food in the house, my sister comes home, she has food but I don't. I was forgotten about, I was mad, I was sad, why did my sister get something, why did they not think of me? But everytime it happened, I just understood that you can't expect to be given anything. 

I wasn't given glamor, I was given a life though, my life was supposed to worse, I was supposed to be brain dead by now, unable to walk, but I'm doing this with you. Grace. Do you have grace? The whole point of all this is just grace. Once you start appreciating even the little things, the things that show you it isn't that bad and you have that freedom of doing more, then it transforms boredom to something more. Maybe it doesn't but everything else doesn't matter because at least you have this. You can want, you can desire, you can be prideful, you can be greedy, but knowing and understanding that you have something, or at least being grateful for it make things a lot better.

blocks.text: How does WhiteEye use the image of a mirror to discuss fear, guilt, and acting for yourself?

I'll tell you this the easiest way I can possibly, and in a complex way you have to understand yourself.

A zebra is a zebra. A boar is a boar. A deer is a deer. They all can see their form, they all can see their reflections or at least their existence from others, and exprience the world as is. A human is not a human but their own reflection of reality. The difference between us and the other mammals, is consciousness, were able to see and think, to ourselves we are more than human, we are not just ourselves but others perceptions. What if I broke that mirror, what if I became human. What does that mean? I live in this world without worry, without the ability of fragility, or without the sense of weighing. Being human isn't losing those things, but having them and still being able to live with them. As humans we have the special ability to do something about ourselves and what we want, but we usually use that mirror, that reflection of others to guide ourselves instead of just walking forward. If you keep walking down the dark forest,  you will feel not like a animal, but prey, when in reality that darkness is the shadows of your mind inhibiting fear. While the real you is walking in a forest. That doesnt mean to not be on guard, but dont allow yourself to create fear and nervousness from unseen or even known problems. A zebra is a zebra. A  boar is a boar. A deer is a deer. They all see their reflection in the water. While you see others. Be human, not another person human. You can doubt, you can be nervous, but what you can't do is put your emotional perception in others and call it truth. Know that you feel that way, but don't make it your driving force. 

As a dog needs food and water to live. You must do what you need to live also. Study, study smart and study hard. Have a schedule you can follow and do the most in. Highlight the most important things in your syllabus and create a plan from it. If you cant, ai can, there is a reason we made technology after all. Help yourself, not destroy. Guilt is but the webs in a corner, there and concerning, but can easily be wiped away when you understand that Guilt is only because you care too much, stop and live freely.

lessons.title: The past as something to learn from
lessons.name: 03.01 The past as something to learn from

blocks.text: How can you look back without making the past your present?

Imma be real. Its 2026. You either live on or live backwards. To me it is useless to think that way. Because once you truly think about it, what does judging your past self do when that person got you to where you are to day, allowed to have a choice, a chance to see and learn from it, to make a choice today or tomorrow or even the next day, to change or evolve, even so slightly. Judging your past is worthless when you already acted and moved on to the next day, but learning from it is valuable, it is the past for reason. You're in the present, what you felt than, how you felt, what you understood, how you thought, what you hated, look at those, look at them truthfully, understand than know that the person there is no longer because the person now was able to look at that person, at their shadows and sit with them in your mind. Your gonna have demons everyday, your gonna have these things that drive you down when it can easily drive you forward. This year, isn't about what you can do, but what shift you're gonna make mentally. Don't fret on what you have done and couldve, focus on what you can do, what you have the potential to do, this is the time to look back and know that with your knowledge, that wisdom now, you can look back and know the potential, the abilities, the thinking, the intelligence you're able to see in your life moving forward. I would say every little thing, every little detail about what you said. But thats useless to me because it'll be the same thing, it'll be useless because it serves nothing but a comfortable mat for the past you had to accept. This is the moment, the time. That reflection, you needed that to see what you always known. Instead of thinking of what was, think what is. That person you saw was pathetic, you could learn so much from that man, and you have so much you can learn from yourself now. You're right you'll be 17, no matter what, you wasted your teens, hell even I did, I said I would, dreamt of doing good things and being better, yet that only came with wisdom, this is life, thats how it is. But the difference is, that it doesnt matter to me, because when I slept, I woke up. And I wake up everyday and if I continue to wake up everyday, than that means I have a infinite amount of opportunity of still doing something right as much as wrong. I can't fail myself, no matter how much I believed that I wasted those moments, those were the times I had, I learned and gained so much from my exprience. So I'll regret anything, because to be pulled by the past, is to be dragged by yourself and only you, and im sorry, no past version of me can't beat me nor drag me, there is nothing that can stop, they may be wise but im wiser, they mightve been smarter educated, but im smarter and more exprienced. Nothing in my mind, nothing make sense to lose to the me who created this reality we have now. The whole point is to learn and become better through time. Why disrespect yourself for everything you went through, instead of walking through the path they made, knowing it may not be the best one. It is useless for me to think bad about myself as no bad words hold no weight against me, I know me more than anyone. You are the same, and capable of such. I'm not saying be like me ofc. But its 2026, it was 2025, 2023, 2021. In a few years this will be but a fleeting moment, a past memory like everything else was. Its time to unshackle yourself from your sins of guilt and resentment, and focus on what you know your responsibility is. You said you would like to kill yourself, but unfortunately you have the responsibility of living, thats it and thats all, whatever you do or what life gives you, is just food on the plate for the exprience called life. Nothing more, nothing less. Its up to you to make it meaningful, create purpose, goals, dreams. Even if you have nothing, you have the opportunity to live and with a mindset, you can have everything.

blocks.text: What are you valuing when you compare results and people?

Does it make it better if it continues to? If it didn't yield results, does that make the actual result meaningless? You’re looking with a glass cup half full as if it was empty. I'll refrain from the harshness. You will age, I will age. Your mother and father, mine as well. They will die, I will, maybe my siblings will die before me even being younger. We dont wish for futures like those, yet we may be brought it. You say progressing age, but it's just progressing isn't it? Each day you age one more. Each hour, each second. But you don't realize until you look back. Do you ever wonder why? What's the importance of looking back 2 seconds ago if nothing has happened anyway? What about an hour? 10? 24? You gain the understanding of not time, but action. Actions reflect the present actions, as it reacted upon the next making you react upon the future that will become the present. You're gonna want more time one day, but not gonna have it. You're gonna have to think ahead, plan, use yourself as creatively as possible. Never overzealous as you'll be dragged under with it. You're just weak. Not in spirit, but in mind. You hold yourself back with doubts, with reasons that only you can validate. That only you can see and only you can feel. Because only you can cause it and only you can create more of it. As everyday progress, time never slows, but at the time we look into the past it does, because time isn't present there. It's something in the wind. I can say everything in the world is meaningless simply because we all will die, that because thats the only place we're equal. If you potentially ceased to succumb to hatred, and doubt, would it change anything, would you be able to push yourself with courage instead of giving yourself self pity and validation to call yourself slightly better then someone else.

lessons.title: Respect and agreements
lessons.name: 08.03 Respect and agreements

blocks.text: How do kindness, respect, and agreements enter your relationships?

One thing I've learned quickly growing up in childhood. No one owes you anything, no one. Doesn't matter if they say they do. Doesn't matter if you shook on it or signed something. Anyone and everyone lives with the same restriction and that's following what is said or what is believed. Because if you dont, you can do anything which means killing, drinking and driving, manipulating, cheating, hurting or fighting without reason because there is no true sense of direction in someone who doesn't believe in it. The same is the other way. You dont owe your mother, father, brothers, friends, me anything. You can just say and feel like you do out of obligation. None of this mean that mutual agreement isnt something to follow, you should always take note of someone for disrespecting you in a light especially after the things you done for them. You can either press the issue and confront them, or forgive them but dont forget and just move away. Sometimes you can do the mixture of both.

Yeah don't let people just overstep and do whatever they want. There's a lot of time because im extermely calm, kind and forgiving. That people did overstep believing that they could do what they want. But all it takes is a small talk and a bit of respect to make them understand. But for racist and overly emotional arrogant people you just ignore them and get on with your life. Especially here in america. Really nothing much bothers me, and depending on the circumstance i am rather more willing to do nothing because there is other things that are importance. Caring what others think should never be what you should care about, unless it's politics in certain situations. I do believe stoicism is just a thing that is easy to live by, you can be emotional but dont be overly emotional. I'm a super empathetic guy so people in my family think once i get in my room after like a death or something id cry or i feel so down but just not showing it for them. I just get over things extremely fast.

Basically all to say, that you can be least emotional, people who understand you as a person will perceive you as someone who has emotion to at least care. If you don't, than you're cold and dont care enough. But its not just in actions, i always say actions prove greater than words but words are more powerful than any action. When around people who jokes on you to make them look better or jokes on you to just have fun, if you feel disrespected or used than you can do a lot of things like spin it on them, buy into the joke than spin it to make it a bigger one, so much more. If you don't care than it doesnt matter. Now being over polite isn't good in the point of if you're unaware you can be used and your emotions can be abused. But you also have to understand for the other person thats true as well. If you're aware and know they use your kindness, than you can easily use their willingness

I dont get this surface understanding of human beings like the same cant be said against the perpetrator. Ive been thinking about it recently. Why dont people understand it or see it. Is it because im too aware or is it just that people just dont take notice of the opposite reaction being true. I think all it is, really comes down to how much you value social contexts and environment. Since all of the things i stand by isn’t centered mainly around myself, i don't find these things to care about. I think mainly because i went through all of the things under the umbrella through kindergarten to basically half of 5th grade, i don't really see it as something valuable unless it needs to be used in some way

But i also don't get disrespected a lot, or really disrespected at all now that i think about it. Really even a lot of the times just being kind can stir the situation in your hands. For me it have many times. A lot of people respect me for it. Even privately or behind my back there is no chatter about me, mainly because i speak to no one and all i do is just help and just chill. Discord is obviously another can of worms, because yeah there is a lot people who have thought i was just acting or faking just because of what i know, or because im so sarcastic they take me serious or they just attack my character to just attack my character in which they mostly just clown themselves because either people protect me or i just get into the joke and spin it completely.

blocks.text: What happens when the same approach keeps producing no response?

So you just did the opposite of what i told you to do. Which is not call him or message him. Because guess what to the average human being thats spamming, excessive and obsessive behavior. All you needed to do was send it, wait for a long time, ask if he seen the message, than if no reply than basically you seen all that you have to. You dont need to call everyday, text everyday for some reason. I told you the message was for him to see how he responds. "The definition of insanity is doing the same thing over and over again and expecting different results." If this was science, a study, a activity, or even math it would be math, but its social, and you do it again and again to another person and not once did you think of changing your approach. Or even thought what is your approach doing. Ofc if he did it to you, he would be fine, but he's not you, he didnt call you back the other ten times why would try another ten, you're not doing it for him but for yourself and that's the insane part. Im not excusing anything that he done. But I don't deal with surface level things even though almost everything is surface level to me. Why do you think I make you ask questions? Why do you think I ask for you to reflect? Also you never answered my question on how you would reflect which shows that you either don't know what reflection means or is or you went around it. He kept saying tomorrow, tomorrow, tomorrow and you said do it when your free. All you have to do is wait after that, and see if he'd actually call, 3 days later, than ask yo you still wanna call, than no answer. Its done. Unless he proves otherwise. Your emotions play you like a puppet. Why do you think I make you at least question or understand something before you choose to do something. I tell you what you need to do, but I cant control you, its up to you to make the change.

blocks.text: How do you think about an outcome that has not happened?

Its not over yet, so why are you already thinking of the end as if its the true ending. Do your best now, think about it later. You already lost once you believed it was impossible, you already lost confidence, and you will never win when you keep seeing the end of things that never came. It's good to plan, but not good to plan on a loss as if you lost already. Plan for backups incase not for losing. This is like everything you've done up until now, and this is the only test that you can really prove to yourself how far are you willing to take yourself to finish what you started. If you can starve yourself for days, you can study for days and learn it under the time limit. You have to put full belief into yourself, become delusional, accept your ego. And if the end comes to be bad, don't be dissapointed or belittled by guilt because at the last moments you did everything you could, you did something. Something that you wouldn't be able to do before the day you started. The sky is not under the sun, all we see is the atmosphere and stars, but those stars are vast and wide. Look into the stars, not the sun, because no matter how far you look there will be a star, meaning no matter how far you see, you'll never be able to see the end, so make yourself so incredibly high in nature, that you to is limitless enough to reach for those vast stars.

Man, this is dissapointing, the old Griffith would be dissapointing that it seem like you completely gave up, and you believed in vegeta. Instead of talking about the end and losing, you should talk about what you can do now to make it easier on yourself and what possible choices you have to study or learn better. lessons.title: Thinking in years
lessons.name: 12.03 Thinking in years

blocks.text: What changes when you give growth more time?

You're 16 almost 17. You have a lot going in your life. Even if it feels like you wasted a lot of time, I want you to not judge that person harshly. As you know now, that person felt like they was doing all they could, even knowing they wasn't, they fought a mental battle for themselves. It mightve felt like you wasted so much. But your 16. One day you might be 37. You're young. You have a life ahead of you, and time to grow and do the things you want. It will never be perfect. It may not be good, or even ok. But as long as you reach for new heights, inspire to do better, you will be able to work for what you want and enjoy your life as is. I want you to stop looking at others, because the only competition you have is the one you create. You have the freedom to express and diversify yourself to become better, that's how you use competition to really scale highly. I need you to do better for yourself. You will have more than most will ever have. If you can starve yourself, if you can keep yourself from being completely addicted to things. Than understand how much more you can do with your mind and body combined. How far you can push yourself to not just be better but be who you want to be. You have start with the mind. The mind is everything. Every thought, emotion connected with thought, every piece of internal struggle. You have to control it and weaponize it to push you even harder. Your body responds to your mind, your mindset is developed through pressure and how you think. Create new ways of thinking, create how the person you would be would think and how would they would act to it. Reinforce it until its true. Until delusion and reality comes together. Forward. Only Forward. You have time, stop thinking in days, weeks, months. Think in years than go backwards. Everything will take time and effort, plan for it, know what you have to do, let nothing distract you from yourself. Be you freely. Stop holding yourself back. You think you aren't? Than stop hiding yourself constantly. Do the things you know you have to do. Think of the things that are completely uncomfortable. You're meant to show yourself off. You're meant to prove that you're pride isnt just egotism. That its the core of radiance itself. Do things smartly, do it with knowledge and research, you know how to because thats your strength, being able to gain the information you need.  The future is what you need to be ready for. The present is what you use to grow, learn, and prepare. The past is there to learn from, understand and reflect to become a better person mentally. Your only 16 almost 17. You're only going to get older. Time will past. Just like it did for your previous years. Don't live in doubt or worry. Don't allow yourself to be held back by fear, anxiety, and emotions. Don't let yourself down. It will take time as it took time for you to be in this spot, able to read this, able to attempt to understand, able to become who you are today. Regret nothing. You are free. Nothing and no one can convince you otherwise. Live your life happily, and if you can't, than make it.

[...]

This is your situation, i trust and believe in you to do whats right for you. I never said go quickly or anything. I want you to take your time. Think in years, become better slowly, stop thinking about just the person you present yourself to be, but what you present to yourself and what you can carry and change through yourself so it can also give to others. All i ask is for you to listen. You dont need to do it. You can go back, there's not many times i said to do this or do that. I just say you can. Because this is your life, not mine. I can't control you. One day you may hate me. One day you may never speak to me again. And that day is a day im always ready for. I dont do this for myself. No matter what im here. Because i want to be. And i want you to get to a point, where you don't need to ask me, dont want my guidance automatically. You're gonna face way tougher challenges than just walking outside and showing yourself in front of people without being nervous in front of someone.

I get it which is why BP is just extermely flawed. Using animals as proof for human social dynamics is flawed just by default. Yes, animals are largely instinct driven, but humans are conscious, social, and cultural beings. Unlike animals, humans override instincts, create norms, moral systems, and complex societies. Example: Humans wear clothes, cook food, and avoid incest even when biology wouldn’t prevent them. Instinct is influential but not deterministic.

 Black pill reasoning cherry-picks correlations (e.g., dopamine spikes, infant gaze preference) and generalizes them to life outcomes. Yes, babies look longer at symmetrical faces, so what? That doesn’t make life long success, power, or respect determined by looks. It just shows a biological bias that is one factor among thousands. Dopamine release is a signal of attention, not of universal value or destiny. People with high competence, creativity, or social skill override this bias constantly. 🥲

lessons.title: Consider the factors a single explanation leaves out
lessons.name: 13.51 Consider the factors a single explanation leaves out

blocks.text: What does WhiteEye say is missed when attraction or relationship quality is reduced to one factor?

“Studies show women aren’t satisfied with less attractive husbands”
This is a misrepresentation of the literature.

What studies actually show:
Physical attraction affects initial desire and short-term arousal

Long-term marital satisfaction correlates more strongly with:

- Emotional attunement
- Perceived fairness
- Partner responsiveness
- Trust
- Shared values
- Conflict resolution
- Large longitudinal studies (e.g., Karney & Bradbury, 1995; Gottman, 1999–2015) show:
Looks predict early attraction
They do NOT predict long term satisfaction or relationship stability.
If attractiveness determined satisfaction:
Divorce rates would be lowest among the most attractive couples (they aren’t)
Celebrity marriages would be the most stable (they aren’t)
Aging would universally destroy relationships (it doesn’t)

“Women want to fuck more attractive men”
This is a desire ≠ behavior error.

Yes:
Humans **fantasize**
Both men and women report attraction to people outside relationships

But:
**Fantasies** are not predictors of action
Sexual **desire** is not equivalent to partner preference
Partner choice ≠ momentary 
arousal

By this logic:
Men watching porn means they don’t love their partners (false)
Thoughts determine reality (they don’t)
You’re confusing sexual cognition with relational decision making. They are neurologically distinct systems. 😭

“Sex feels good because it’s for reproduction”
Again, origin ≠ meaning.

If sex were functionally reproduction:
Infertile people wouldn’t desire it (they do)
Same-sex sex wouldn’t exist (it does)
Non-fertile sex wouldn’t be common (it is)
Sexual boredom wouldn’t exist (it does)

Sex in humans functions as:
Bonding
Regulation
Validation
Identity expression
Stress relief
Intimacy
Reproduction is one function, not the definition

“Contraception isn’t natural, so it doesn’t count”
This is an appeal to nature fallacy. (Again 😂)

By this logic:
Glasses don’t count (not natural)
Medicine doesn’t count
Phones don’t count
Civilization doesn’t count
Humans **override biology constantly.**

If something has existed for Centuries, Across cultures, or At massive scale. Then it is part of human reality, regardless of evolutionary origin.
**Natural ≠ relevant.**

“Men who have sex a lot are seen with more respect than women”

This is **cultural**(something ive been pointing out), not biological. It’s called a sexual double standard, documented in sociology.

Example: In many patriarchal societies, male promiscuity is praised, female promiscuity is punished. That’s social enforcement, not a law of nature.

Evidence,
Clark & Hatfield (1989): Men and women respond differently to casual sex offers. but this is about social perception, not “biology.”
Social norms shift constantly: In some modern Western contexts, women having casual sex is normalized. In Scandinavian countries, sexual liberation is largely gender-neutral.
Biology doesn’t dictate respect. Cultural norms dictate respect. You're conflating the two. 😭😭

“It isn’t natural to not want to create babies… it’s why we exist”

This is a classic appeal to nature fallacy.

Humans don’t exist solely to reproduce. we exist as complex social beings with culture, technology, and choice. Many healthy humans choose not to have children and that doesn’t make them “unnatural” or ill. Reproduction is optional in humans. Evolution doesn’t dictate every behavior, it provides tendencies, not moral rules (and i dont even believe in morality). 😂 For example:
Some people naturally avoid sugar (survival advantage)
Some people naturally enjoy sugar (modern consequence: obesity risk)
Trying to reduce human value and morality to reproduction is over-simplistic and biologically naive.

Biology provides tendencies, not deterministic rules. Environment, culture, and individual choice dominate human outcomes.

Just because people often choose healthier partners doesn’t prove genetics “rules” social worth or attraction universally. Caring about a partner for the child’s health is rational strategy, not primal instinct. Evolutionary pressures do not require conscious choice, they only explain trends over generations. Modern humans can consciously avoid having kids or choose partners for non genetic reasons. And also you just move past against actual relationship and emotional factors weighed in too 💀

blocks.text: What does WhiteEye think a tree can help me notice about life and dependence?

Trees grow in many different areas, different ways, different barks. Some grow big, skinny, long, stable. They react different to different weathers, events and problems. They have resources differently that insects, animals or humans use. While they grow its like a competition of who get the most sunlight, the bigger ones have the higher advantage, they take up more area and space. So they grow larger than the trees under them because how much sun light they're given. They even have different leaves, some sharp, some different colored than others, with different proprieties. But just as big they can get, they can get cut down, burned, destroyed. The ones that uplift and give life, so crucial, can be overlooked just for another gain. They're capable of being used in different ways. Different structural processes. Like houses, tables, or even pencils. You can call them the structure and holder of a lot of things. When you depend on something so much, you can end up hurting it.

The more you take away, the more scarce it becomes. The more it hurts you in the process. Speaking about oxygen obviously. There's a lot of relational ideas and patterns you can see from how trees themselves live and grow, vs insects/wildlife uses it, and humans as well.

You can learn a lot just from observing life itself. Life itself encompass all things even death. Ofc which is how we learn a lot, create ideas. But even the systems they follow and how the process or go about different situations. Humans are just another part of life, big ants upon smaller ones.
In a lot of ways... its beautiful. In some ways its dark.

Desire

I want to be someone who can make people better, to give them hope through despair. Ofc it's respectable and something you can go for, but it's goofy because it's a desire. A desire is literally wanting more then what you want in the present because you feel you have enough, when in reality you have more then what you need to do something. "I want" instead I can just be, but I need to confirmation to myself that it happens.
Course note: Read alongside: [[09.05 Desire curiosity and will]].
Will and curiosity

No. As I said its will. To have will isn't to desire, it's a force that perpetually grows and goes forward. Do you know what it means to have no desire? To just keep going without a moment of feeling? Will creates curiosity towards desire. You imagine do to your will to imagine, and whatever you imagine creates a curiosity to understand, not desire. The thing about desire it's to have something, to need more, not in a greed sense but just a emotional or deep sensation of need or want. We're not gluttony. But pure curiosity wonders, it's a will of imagination to see, you don't desire to see, you just do.
Course note: Read alongside: [[09.05 Desire curiosity and will]].

There's nothing like being too grateful. I'm grateful for everything, the air, the grass, the ability to feel, the ability to connect, my emotions, my past, to be able to perceive, to be able to be grateful, to be put in a position where good happens and even when bad happens I can learn from it. I used to literally name things just because I was that grateful, but I want to be better, because of the things I'm grateful for because I know and understand that there is people that can't be grateful for it due to not having it.

Reflection and questioning

See you need to increase your awareness. Question answers with more questions, break down your answers, explain deeper and fully. Don't go for a simple answer, even when the answer is simple, tell why is it simple for you. Learn to ask more deeper reflective questions, so you can fully realize yourself internally. 

Don't do it how I do it, because I am responding to you, so for me I'd just give you questions to what you said. 

You can even question what I just said, how did I realize it, what awareness did I have over my question and why. 

You see how I interacted then questioned it and gave you something else to look at. That's what you have to work on. 

If I'm answering something like what is loneliness? I would say my answer, then expand on my answer with a answer to another question about some parts of it. If I were to say. 

[Answer] Loneliness to me is just the act of being in a black void, where nothing is around you but everything you can see everything [answer question] When I think of a black void in accordance to loneliness, what i mean is a feeling of emptiness, a part of you not being completely present. Because loneliness isn't just being there, it's being there and realizing everything you see isn't there with you. [Answer question] I think a lot of people exprience loneliness because of not being with themselves a lot, or not seeing themselves as comfort. When you're lonely, you don't have anyone and unfortunately you feel like you don't have you either. It's dark, while bright because it's a illusion at the end of the day. [Answer question] an illusion that shadows that brightness, make you feel uneasy, like many things don't matter because they don't interact with you. Why should it matter if you don't even acknowledge it in your existence. And what happens when you don't believe you exist. It's fucked, but to get out of it, you have to realize that you're only alone internally, externally you still have other, you just don't reach out. But it also doesn't matter whether connection happens or not, it's only a matter if you value it. [Answer question] and when I say that, connection is everything, I feel connected to the trees, the world around me, because I know I'm not lonely or alone, I just am. I'm me. I'm the only one who is me. And I can only value what's infront of me, not what others value infront of them.

Obsession and passion

While the obsessed will do the effort it takes to get there while not truly looking for shortcuts and do it solely because they want to create that outcome. Wisdom

Not really. I understand you and what you're saying. Many have felt like this. Told me their problems. Many also did nothing, but they at least had a better mind to guide them. I don't get mad or angry at you, sometimes you do annoy me with how painfully pridefully stubborn you can be. But I know that's how humans are and I can't directly change that. I can only influence, persuade you that what I say has truth in it. My words hold no meaning without you to give them. You've done well, you also tried what you though was your best but as many before and Many after, will realize that is not the case especially in the moment they need it to be true. But in that moment we learn so much more, on how we could've, on how we did, or the why of what we did. That's what wisdom is for. And how it builds. You'll feel like a fool now, but you will also how much more you were then, and then it is possible to understand what it means to be a fool. Everyone in this world seeks perfection in their image, but sadly were not perfect by design, we have capability to be near but naught. As god would see, as I would tell it, none of what will come will be perfect in image but in continuous nature, it will be. You have to push past this self deceit so you can go even much further. Open doors within yourself with a mind that understand and sees the flaws without seeking only negative. You have the ability to think, listen and feel. Harmonize with yourself and you may feel as if your heart has been shaped by something more. Because then you'll know where pain comes from, and the opposite rest at also. To me all humans are like children, so I do not expect anyone to be perfect nor in my expectations, because I can't judge perfectly as anyone else. You're simply misguided. That's all.
